intent_and_difference: Add owner-confirmed quotation, 30 km measurement or one-year warranty boundary to the actual published FAQ row; question and sort order preserved.

desired_fields.answer_zh: 请提供地点、空间类型、大约面积、现场照片、现有问题和计划工程。免费报价按确认范围准备；量房是否安排需核对现场与时间。距离公司或服务点 30 公里以内可免费上门量房，超过 30 公里会收费，费用须预约前确认。
desired_fields.answer_en: Share the location, space type, approximate area, photos, issues and proposed work. A free quotation follows the confirmed scope; site-review arrangements depend on access and schedule. Measurement is free within 30 km of the company or service point. Travel beyond 30 km is chargeable; confirm the amount before the appointment.
